### Props

| Name       | Type      | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `showName` | `boolean` |          | `true`  | Render the flow's name in this row, and make the row a heading. True for a host with no heading of its own, which is the embedded dialog. Under NcAppSidebar the name is the sidebar's heading, so the row is a plain div carrying the dot and the pills under it. |
